what:
User-directed design decisions for hook visibility fast-follow (Apr 22 2026, refines mems #175, #307, #310):

**Visibility philosophy (user-specified):**
- Don't duplicate what Claude Code already shows (MCP tool responses, tool-call chrome)
- Surface what's otherwise invisible
- Every visible hook event leads with `aide-memory · ...` for brand consistency
- Include function names (aide_recall / aide_search / aide_remember / aide_update) so users learn the toolchain

**TWO separate channels — do not conflate:**
- **Reason text / agent instructions:** Claude acts on this. Mention aide_update alongside aide_remember EVERYWHERE aide_remember is currently prompted.
- **systemMessage (user-facing):** reassurance + branding. Not instructional.

**Fast-follow ship list (finalized Apr 22 2026):**

### User-facing systemMessages
| Hook | systemMessage |
|---|---|
| pre-read-recall (soft) | aide-memory · prompting aide_recall for scoped memories |
| pre-read-recall (hard) | aide-memory · prompting aide_recall for scoped memories (expected flow) |
| pre-edit-recall (soft) | aide-memory · prompting aide_recall for scoped memories |
| pre-edit-recall (hard) | aide-memory · prompting aide_recall for scoped memories (expected flow) |
| pre-search-nudge | aide-memory · prompting aide_search for "{term}" — {N} matching memories |
| detect-correction | aide-memory · correction detected — prompting aide_remember as preference |
| session-start-clear | aide-memory · injected {N} memories at session start ({layers}) — only if injected |
| stop-remember (correction-pending) | aide-memory · correction from this turn was not saved — prompting aide_remember |
| stop-remember (schedule) | aide-memory · checkpoint — prompting aide_remember for anything critical (expected) |
| pre-compact-save | no change (silent cleanup — housekeeping) |
| track-recall / track-remember / track-search | no change (MCP tool response already visible) |

### Agent-facing — add "(or aide_update if an existing memory needs revision)"

EXACT wording: "(or aide_update if an existing memory needs revision)" — inline where aide_remember is prompted.

All places:

Handlers.ts (src/memory/hooks/handlers.ts):
- Line 346 — FALLBACK constant
- Line 366 — correction detection path A (preferences/technical)
- Line 375 — correction detection path B (area_context/technical)
- Line 384 — correction detection path C (preferences)
- Line 425 — DEFAULT_PROMPT (Stop schedule reason)
- Line 441 — Stop correction-pending reason

Rules / templates (instruct agent to save):
- .claude/rules/aide-memory.md (Stop description, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, proactive save, "When to call" section)
- src/templates/rules/claude-code.md
- src/templates/rules/codex.md
- src/templates/rules/copilot.md
- src/templates/rules/cursor.mdc
- src/templates/rules/windsurf.md

Do NOT add to aide_recall or aide_search prompts — different tool family.

**Config:**
- New `hooks.visible` boolean (default true) in `scripts/hooks/defaults.json`
- Include description field (new convention on every config key as of 0.4.3)
- No rename needed — `nudge.visible` was already removed in dead-key cleanup commit

**Docs to update:**
- **docs/PRODUCT_VISION.md** — directional note about visibility
- **docs/specs/PHASE_0_1_SPEC.md** — explicit "what shipped vs. what will be follow-ups" updates; visibility marked shipped, post-search-check + Option G as follow-ups with spec pointers
- **docs/specs/PHASE_0_1_VALIDATION_FOLLOWUPS.md** — mark items done, add Option G + post-search-check as follow-ups
- **Internal rules + templates** — mechanical aide_update addition per scope above
- **aide-memory-web/pages/docs/quick-start.mdx** — has a config section, ADD `hooks.visible` row (also consider cleaning up stale `hooks.enabled` entry which isn't in current defaults.json)
- **aide-memory-web/pages/docs/faq.mdx** — already has "How do I see nudges in the logs?"; ADD two new entries: "Why do I see PreToolUse:Read hook returned blocking error?" + "How do I reduce / disable hook blocks?" (per mem #320)

**Deferred to Phase 1 follow-ups:**
- **post-search-check hook** — PostToolUse:Grep/Glob emits reminder if aide_search was skipped. Needs new hook + cache tracking.
- **Option G / `recall.mode: autoInject`** — architectural spec at `docs/specs/PHASE_1_FOLLOWUP_AUTO_INJECT_RECALL.md`

**State verified on origin/feature/phase-1 @ 9858236 (0.4.3 release):**
- defaults.json has 20+ keys with description fields; no nudge.visible
- src/memory/config.ts no longer references nudge.visible
- memories.softening.threshold (default 10) auto-softens small projects

**PreToolUse "blocking error" label:**
- Hardcoded in Claude Code, cannot override (mem #310 binary decompile)
- Docs must be transparent about this limitation AND list configurable block levers (mem #320)

**User greenlight received Apr 22 2026.** Starting implementation.

**Methodological note:** always read handler code before writing per-hook design proposals.
